text: Our engine telemetry (agello/telemetry, agello-next 7b872544) defines five levels in agello_telemetry.h: 0 off; 1 counters and anomalies; 2 adds span aggregates (count, total, max, log2 histogram) and DynamicTracing signposts; 3 adds per-thread span ring buffers written as a Chrome/Perfetto trace; 4 adds diagnostic modes that change timing (per-kernel GPU timing, numerical probes); the counter, span, gauge, anomaly and logit probes read the level with one relaxed atomic load before recording anything, while engine facts (SetFact) are stored at every level, 0 included.
